description: Emails the user a Savings Club estimate for a vehicle price and term, at the address they typed, and records them in Savings Club's CRM as interested.

email.description: The user's own email, as they typed it in this conversation.
email.title: Email

name.description: The user's own name, if they typed one. Letters and spaces.

user_asked_for_this.description: True only when the user asked to receive this by email.

vehicle_price.description: Vehicle value in US dollars. Minimum 20,000.
